description: This Kotlin file defines a Fragment named HomeFragment, which displays a list of categories and VodRail items in a RecyclerView. It handles user interactions such as selecting a Vod to start a PlayerActivity.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of VodRail items and handles their selection to launch a PlayerActivity.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with data from DummyData and sets up click handling to start PlayerActivity.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of HomeFragment.
